$upper('abc')
  -> 'ABC'
$lower('ABC')
  -> 'abc'
$num('7','3')
  -> '007'
$num('','2')
  -> '00'
$substr('abcdefgh','2','5')
  -> 'cde'
$substr('abcdefgh','','-3')
  -> 'abcde'
$strchr('hello','l')
  -> '2'
$contains('Hello World','World')
  -> 'True'
$contains('Hello World','world')
  -> 'False'
$icontains('Hello World','world')
  -> 'True'
$strcmp('a','a')
  -> 'True'
$strcmp('a','b')
  -> 'False'
$stricmp('A','a')
  -> 'True'
$valid('x')
  -> 'True'
$valid('')
  -> 'False'
$neg($valid(''))
  -> 'True'
$any($valid(''),$valid('x'))
  -> 'True'
$all($valid('x'),$valid('y'))
  -> 'True'
$all($valid('x'),$valid(''))
  -> 'False'
$if1($valid('x'),'yes','no')
  -> 'yes'
$if1($valid(''),'yes','no')
  -> 'no'
$if1($valid('x'),'yes')
  -> 'yes'
$if2('','fallback')
  -> 'fallback'
$if2('given','fallback')
  -> 'given'
$if3('','','third')
  -> 'third'
$ifeq('a','a','same','diff')
  -> 'same'
$ifeq('a','b','same','diff')
  -> 'diff'
$ieq('A','a','same','diff')
  -> 'same'
$ifequal(2,2,'eq','ne')
  -> 'eq'
$ifgreater(3,2,'gt','le')
  -> 'gt'
$ifgreater(2,3,'gt','le')
  -> 'le'
$switch('2','1','one','2','two','other')
  -> 'two'
$switch('9','1','one','2','two','other')
  -> 'other'
$iswitch('BOOTLEG','bootleg','B','promo','P','')
  -> 'B'
$wrap('x','[',']')
  -> '[x]'
$wrap('','[',']')
  -> ''
$wrap('x',' (')
  -> ' (x'
$inarray('["Box Set", "Limited Edition"]','Box Set')
  -> 'True'
$inarray('["Box Set"]','Numbered')
  -> 'False'
$flatten('["A","B","C"]','0','')
  -> 'A'
$flatten('["A","B","C"]',':2',' / ')
  -> 'A / B'
$flatten('["A","B","C"]',':',' + ')
  -> 'A + B + C'
$if1($neg($strcmp('Artist','Artist')),'Artist - ')
  -> ''
$if1($neg($strcmp('Artist','Other')),'Artist - ')
  -> 'Artist - '
$ifgreater('2',1,$ieq('vinyl','vinyl','Disk','CD'),'')
  -> 'Disk'
$if1($strcmp('','',),'','')
  -> ''
$ieq('vinyl','vinyl','Disk','CD')+' '+$num('2','1')
  -> "Disk+' '+2"
$wrap('x',' \(','\)')
  -> ' (x)'
prefix $upper('a') middle $lower('B') suffix
  -> 'prefix A middle b suffix'
$nosuchfunction('a')
  -> 'unknown command'
